title: potentilla anserina subvar. incisa
intro: Potentilla anserina subvar. incisa, commonly known as Silver Cinquefoil, is a plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae) that is native to Northern Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and supporting wound healing, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of P. anserina subvar. incisa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. The plant's extracts have been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine.
